products.product_description: ClassDojo Tutoring is an online platform connecting K-12 students with certified teachers for personalized 1-on-1 instruction in reading, math, science, and enrichment subjects.

WeVideo is a cloud-based collaborative video creation and interactive learning platform that enables students and educators to capture, edit, share, and collaborate on video projects, podcasts, and digital media.

products.product_description: Amplify CKLA (Core Knowledge Language Arts) is a K–5 core literacy curriculum program that provides structured instruction in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. It is used by educators for English language arts instruction.

Amplify Desmos Math is a mathematics curriculum program that delivers problem-based instruction and interactive activities for teaching math concepts. It is used by K–12 educators for classroom mathematics instruction.
Amplify ELA is a literacy curriculum program that provides instruction in reading, writing, and text analysis. It is used by middle and high school educators for English language arts instruction.

mCLASS DIBELS is a literacy assessment system that measures early reading skills through standardized benchmark and progress monitoring assessments. It is used by K–12 educators to assess foundational literacy development.
i-Ready Inform is an online adaptive assessment that measures students’ reading and mathematics skills to identify learning needs and provide educators with data to guide instruction.

i‑Ready Personalized Learning is an online instructional program that delivers individualized reading and mathematics lessons based on student performance to support skill development and help address learning gaps.
Amplify Classroom is a digital curriculum platform that delivers standards-aligned instructional materials, assessments, and classroom management tools for K–12 educators and students.

BrainPOP is an educational technology platform offering animated movies, interactive quizzes, and activities across various subjects for students in grades K-8. It focuses on making complex topics engaging and accessible through multimedia content and supporting diverse learning styles.

BrainPOP ELL is an interactive language learning platform that provides English language learners with engaging content, including animated movies, games, quizzes, and interactive features, to develop their listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. The platform supports skill development through conversational English modeled by characters and integrates vocabulary, language, and content lessons.

BrainPOP Jr. is an educational platform offering animated movies, interactive quizzes, games, and activities across various subjects for students in kindergarten through third grade. It aims to make learning engaging and accessible by providing content through multiple modalities, fostering curiosity, and supporting diverse learning styles.

BrainPOP Science is a middle school science curriculum platform built around scaffolded, standards-aligned investigations that use real-world phenomena, simulations, data manipulatives, and an embedded Claim-Evidence-Reasoning process. It is designed for students in grades 6-8.

CK-12 Foundation provides a comprehensive platform offering free online textbooks (FlexBooks), videos, adaptive practice, simulations, and real-world applications for K-12 students. The platform integrates AI to deliver personalized educational content and resources across various subjects, aiming to make quality education accessible.

CommonLit is a literacy curriculum and reading comprehension platform that provides reading lessons, texts, and assessments for ELA instruction in grades 6–12. It is used in classroom and independent reading activities.

Formative is a real-time instructional and assessment platform designed for K-12 educators. It allows teachers to create digital lessons and assessments, monitor student work live as it happens, and provide immediate feedback.

Frax is a fraction instruction program that provides adaptive lessons and practice in fraction concepts, operations, decimals, ratios, and proportional reasoning for students in grades 3–9. It is used to build conceptual understanding and procedural fluency with fractions and related mathematics.

Gizmos is a STEM simulation library that provides interactive simulations and inquiry-based lessons in science and mathematics topics such as biology, chemistry, physics, Earth science, algebra, and geometry. It is used by K–12 educators to support concept exploration, virtual labs, and problem-solving activities.

Lexia Core5® Reading is an adaptive literacy instruction program that provides personalized reading instruction across phonological awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary, and comprehension for students in pre-K through grade 5. It is used to support core instruction and reading intervention.

Lexia English Language Development™ provides instruction in speaking, listening, grammar, vocabulary, and academic language for K–6 multilingual learners. It is used to support English language acquisition alongside core classroom instruction.

Lexia PowerUp Literacy® is an adaptive literacy intervention program that provides personalized instruction in decoding, word recognition, grammar, and reading comprehension for students in grades 6–12 who need additional reading support. It is used in intervention and supplemental literacy instruction.

Mathway is a math problem-solving application that lets students enter math problems and receive step-by-step solutions for topics including algebra, geometry, trigonometry, calculus, statistics, and finite math. It is used to solve, check, and review math problems across a range of grade levels.

Newsela is an instructional content platform designed to bridge real-world media and classroom learning for students in grades 3–12. It converts authentic, current-events news and cross-curricular content--ELA (English Language Arts), Social Studies, STEM, and Writing--into accessible learning materials.

NoRedInk is a writing instruction platform that provides grammar practice, revision activities, and scaffolded writing assignments in areas such as sentence structure, usage, essay writing, and text-based analysis. It is used in grades 3–12 for English language arts instruction and writing practice.
Pear Deck is an educational technology platform that transforms static presentations—like Google Slides and Microsoft PowerPoint—into interactive, student-engaging experiences.

PebbleGo is a digital learning platform designed for K-5 students, offering nonfiction articles, eBooks, and teaching resources to support literacy skills and build knowledge in subjects like science and social studies. It features read-aloud audio, rich vocabulary support, and multimodal learning tools.

ReadWorks is a nonprofit educational technology organization that provides a reading comprehension and literacy instruction platform for K-12 students and teachers. The ReadWorks platform features reading passages, comprehension question and vocabulary sets, and writing activities for K–12 English language arts instruction. It is used to support close reading, background knowledge building, and reading comprehension.

Seesaw Elementary LMS is a learning management system that enables students to create and share classwork and allows teachers to assign, review, and communicate about learning activities in elementary classrooms.

SparkNotes is a study guide and literature reference resource that provides chapter summaries, literary analysis, study questions, and test preparation materials for literature, history, and other academic subjects. It is used by secondary and college-level students to review assigned texts and course content.
TypingClub is a keyboarding instruction program that teaches typing skills through structured lessons. It is used by students to develop typing speed and accuracy.

Book Creator is an intuitive EdTech platform designed to empower students and teachers to create and publish interactive digital books incorporating text, images, audio, and video. It supports diverse learning styles and encourages creative expression, making learning accessible and engaging for all users.
